data.rationale: The proposal gets the core procedure in the right order (From/To with suggestions, trip type, dates, search, continue, Sort & Filter, apply), but it leaves out the payment type (cash/points) step and parameter and hardcodes the sort as "price low to high" instead of making sort_option a parameter, so an automation built from it couldn't cover the points or other sort variations.
